title: Tableflow cluster-id resolution is broken: driver never runs the CMK lookup
description: database_kafka_cluster_id was removed from ConfluentCredentials, open(), and tests/conftest.py, and the docs now direct users to a 'confluent api-key create --resource global' key on the premise that the driver resolves the lkc- id from schema via CMK. On the pinned confluent-sql that premise does not hold: _resolve_kafka_cluster_id gates on _global_credentials, and open() passes the pair as tableflow_api_key, so _global_credentials is None and the lookup is never attempted. Any model with a tableflow config therefore fails with ProgrammingError('Resolving the Kafka cluster id from the database name requires a global API key').
design: Verified live 2026-09-15: a --resource global key returns 200 from /cmk/v2 by curl, yet confluent_sql.connect(tableflow_api_key=<that key>, ...) still raises, because the gate is on the credential slot and not on reachability. Fix upstream by gating on _controlplane_auth (which CMK and Tableflow already share) instead of _global_credentials -- one line; patch at /tmp/confluent-sql-cmk-controlplane-auth.patch, 1315 upstream unit tests pass, not yet pushed. Then re-pin confluent-sql in pyproject.toml. The fix only helps global-scoped keys: a --resource tableflow key gets 401 from CMK, so that scope will always need an explicit cluster id.
acceptance_criteria: A model with a tableflow config runs green against Confluent Cloud with only a --resource global key in global_api_key and no database_kafka_cluster_id in the profile; tests/functional/adapter/test_tableflow.py passes.

title: Tableflow API 401s Confluent Cloud API keys in the test org
description: Every Tableflow functional test fails on the first GET with "Error reading Tableflow topic '401' - Unauthorized". Not an adapter bug: /tableflow/v1/* returns a bare 401 for Basic auth with a resource_type=cloud key, while /org/v2 and /cmk/v2 return 200 for the same credential. Reproduced with a user-owned key and a freshly created service-account key, both OrganizationAdmin; the same URL returns 200 with the confluent CLI session JWT. Needs escalation to whoever owns Tableflow API auth, or a key known to work against /tableflow/v1. Until then the functional tests cannot be verified.
notes: ROOT CAUSE (2026-09-15): not an org entitlement problem. The key was resource_type=cloud, which /tableflow/v1 does not accept. Verified matrix (curl, env-v98poj) flinksql|tableflow|cmk: flink-region 200|401|401, cloud 404|401|200, tableflow 404|200|401, global 200|200|200. Fix: create the control-plane key with 'confluent api-key create --resource global' (needs CMK too) or '--resource tableflow' (Tableflow only). bootstrap.sh now creates a global key and probes all three routes.

title: Code quality fixes from 2026-09-08 review (connections.py, impl.py, utils.py)
description:
## Why this exists

Applied all 11 open/partial items from docs/plans/2026-09-08-code-quality-review.md to
dbt/adapters/confluent/connections.py, dbt/adapters/confluent/impl.py, and
dbt/adapters/confluent/utils.py. All 317 unit tests pass; ruff reports no issues.

## What was done

### connections.py

**Issue 1 (🔴 High) — Iterative retry loop:**
Rewrote `_execute_query_with_retry` from unbounded recursion to a `while True` loop.
`limit` is now a mutable loop variable so the extended 12-retry budget for
is_being_modified/is_topic_gone correctly accumulates across iterations instead of
being re-applied per recursive frame.

**Issue 2 (🔴 High) — Exception narrowing in open():**
Added an explicit `except confluent_sql.Error` branch before the bare
`except Exception` in `open()`, matching what `confluent_sql.connect()` actually
raises for connection-level failures. Both branches still mark connection.state='fail'
and re-raise with original diagnostics intact.

**Issue 2 (🔴 High) — exception_handler TODO resolved:**
Replaced unresolved TODO with a clear rationale explaining why `confluent_sql.Error`
is caught at the full hierarchy level and why `fire_event` is intentionally not used.

**Issue 9 (🟢 Low) — commit/begin TODOs resolved:**
Replaced both TODO comments with an explanatory note: these are deliberate silent no-ops
because dbt's transaction machinery calls them around every query; raising would break
all queries.

**Issue 10 (🟢 Low) — unique_field simplified:**
Replaced verbose if/else with `return self.endpoint or ...`.

**Issue 12 (🟢 Low) — ConnectionState enum consistency:**
`connection.state = 'open'` (string literal) replaced with
`connection.state = ConnectionState.OPEN` (enum constant) to match the guard check
at the top of `open()`.

### impl.py

**Issue 11 (🟢 Low) — _CleanupRegistry.relations generic type:**
`self.relations: list = []` typed as `list[ConfluentRelation]`.

**Issue 4 (🟡 Medium) — _is_yes() helper:**
New module-level helper `_is_yes(val)` handles bool, int, and string inputs robustly.
All three fragile `str(...).upper() == 'YES'` call-sites replaced with `_is_yes(...)`.

**Issue 5 (🟡 Medium) — rename_relation substitution guard:**
After `pattern.sub(...)`, added `if new_ddl == ddl: raise DbtDatabaseError(...)` so a
failed substitution raises a clear error instead of silently passing bad DDL to execute.

**Issue 6 (🟡 Medium) — parse_unit_test_ctes unguarded .index():**
`cte_sql.index(' as (')` replaced with `.find()` plus an explicit
`if as_idx == -1: raise ValueError(...)` that includes the offending cte_sql.

**Issue 7 (🟡 Medium) — _get_one_catalog dict guard (residual):**
`row = dict(row)` added before mutation so the assumption is explicit and will fail
loudly if execute_macro ever returns non-dict rows.

### utils.py

**Issue 8 (🟡 Medium) — fetchmany_with_retry accumulation loop:**
The unbounded loop now fetches `remaining = limit - len(results)` rows per iteration
instead of `limit`, allowing it to accumulate across multiple partial batches up to
the total limit rather than immediately exiting after the first full-page batch.

## Acceptance criteria

- All items in the plan summary table at status 'Open' or 'Partial' are addressed
- 317 unit tests pass (`uv run pytest tests/unit/`)
- `ruff check` reports no issues on the three changed files
- Issue 3 (TableflowManager extraction) and Issue 7 (fully mitigated) deliberately
  excluded from this task per plan status
close_reason: All 11 open/partial items from the 2026-09-08 review applied. 317 unit tests pass, ruff clean.
